def test_remove_vowels():
    # Basic cases
    assert remove_vowels("") == ""
    assert remove_vowels("abcdef") == "bcdf"
    assert remove_vowels("aaaaa") == ""
    assert remove_vowels("aaBAA") == "B"
    assert remove_vowels("zbcd") == "zbcd"

    # Mixed case vowels
    assert remove_vowels("AbCdEfG") == "bCdfG"
    assert remove_vowels("AEIOUaeiou") == ""

    # Sentence-like input
    assert remove_vowels("Hello, World!") == "Hll, Wrld!"
    assert remove_vowels("Testing 123") == "Tstng 123"

    # No vowels at all
    assert remove_vowels("xyz xyz") == "xyz xyz"

    # Vowel-only edge cases
    assert remove_vowels("a") == ""
    assert remove_vowels("A") == ""

    # Numbers and symbols preserved
    assert remove_vowels("12345!@#") == "12345!@#"

    assert remove_vowels("a b c") == "  b c"
